sections.title: Facebook & Instagram ads for beauty, explained honestly

items.title: Creative that stops the beauty scroll
items.body:
On Meta, the creative is the targeting: the algorithm shows your ad to whoever engages with it, so the video decides your audience more than any setting. Beauty feeds are the most visually competitive on earth — polished-but-fake loses to authentic treatment-room content with a sharp hook, nearly every time.

We produce in batches and test hooks against each other: the transformation open, the price reveal, the “things nobody tells you” angle, the POV booking journey. Winners scale; losers die in days, not months.

sections.embed:
The close

From DM to deposit: where campaigns win or die

Here’s the uncomfortable truth about beauty ads in the UAE: the sale doesn’t happen on the ad — it happens in the DM. “How much?”, “Do you have Saturday?”, “Does it hurt?” Every unanswered question is paid budget evaporating.
That’s why our Meta campaigns ship with the response layer included: comment automation captures every “😮❤️ price??”, instant replies answer in seconds, and the AI booking bot walks the client from question to confirmed appointment — with a deposit if you want one, which alone cuts no-shows dramatically.

sections.title: Meta ads questions owners ask, answered straight

items.title: Boosting posts vs. running real ads — what's the difference?
items.text: Boosting optimises for engagement (likes, comments); Ads Manager campaigns optimise for what you actually want — leads and bookings — with proper audiences, placements, exclusions and tracking. Same money, wildly different outcomes.

items.title: What budget do Instagram ads need in Dubai?
items.text: Meaningful booking volume usually starts at AED 2,500–5,000/month in ad spend. Beauty cost-per-lead in the UAE typically runs AED 8–25 with proper creative — the simulator above shows the maths for your number.

items.title: Do I need new content every month?
items.text: Yes — creative fatigue is real and arrives in about three weeks. That's why production is included: a monthly batch of reels and statics, planned before the current winners burn out.

items.title: Lead forms, WhatsApp or landing pages — which converts best?
items.text: In the UAE beauty market, WhatsApp-first paths usually win on volume and speed; lead forms win for premium consultations needing qualification; landing pages win for high-ticket packages. We route each campaign to its best fit — and test.

items.title: How do you measure bookings, not likes?
items.text: Pixel + conversions API + DM attribution: every campaign reports conversations started, leads captured and appointments booked, with revenue attached. Reach and likes appear in the appendix, where they belong.

items.title: What about Ramadan, wedding season and summer?
items.text: They're the calendar's profit peaks — each gets a planned offer, creative set and budget shift weeks in advance. Beauty demand in the UAE is seasonal; your ad account should breathe with it.

sections.title: Instagram & Facebook ads — before you ask

items.q: How long until the store is live?
items.a: First leads typically arrive within days of launch; the machine hits stride by weeks 3–4 once learning completes and the first creative iteration lands.

items.q: Do you create the content, or do we?
items.a: We do — reels, statics and story creative are produced as part of the service. If you have great treatment footage, even better: we’ll cut it into ads. If you have nothing, we’ll plan a shoot day at your location.

items.q: What if my clinic has no photos or videos at all?
items.a: That’s normal and fixable in one afternoon. We script a phone-shot content day — treatments, rooms, team — that fuels months of ads. Authentic beats glossy on Meta anyway.

items.q: What's the minimum budget to start?
items.a: AED 2,500/month in ad spend is a workable floor for one strong offer in one area; we’ll tell you honestly what your budget can and can’t achieve before you commit.

items.q: Do you also manage our organic Instagram?
items.a: That’s our Social Media Management service — it pairs perfectly with ads (organic proof makes ads convert better), and many clients run both under one plan.
